Thornhill, Maple Ridge: 13 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 8 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Thornhill fell from 21 in June to 13 in September (−38.1%), and 8 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 3.2% of Maple Ridge’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Thornhill?
Thornhill also had 8 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in September, against 13 houses listed. The Thornhill condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Thornhill?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Thornhill. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Thornhill a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Thornhill had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Thornhill from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Thornhill over those 4 months, out of 188 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Thornhill?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
